organizations.publicNote: Linked discographic sources identify Gloria as a German-market record label in the Lindström group.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria, “Adieu es ist zu schön um wahr zu sein” (Bernhard Etté, 1933)
sources.fullCitation: Bernhard Etté mit seinem Tanz-Orchester, vocal by Wolfgang Schmidt. “Adieu es ist zu schön um wahr zu sein.” Tango by Walter Jurmann, Bronislaw Kaper and Fritz Rotter from Abenteuer am Lido. YouTube transfer published by Radiomuseum Hardthausen, 1933. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: Adieu, es ist zu schön, um wahr zu sein — Gloria, Bernhard Etté
sources.creator: Bernhard Etté mit seinem Tanz-Orchester; Wolfgang Schmidt, vocal
sources.researchNote: The upload description identifies a 1933 Lindström recording issued on Gloria in Germany and Odeon elsewhere, but gives no catalogue number. The disc label is not shown.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10197, “Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen?”
sources.fullCitation: Melody Gents with orchestra. “Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen?” Slowfox from Ehe mit beschränkter Haftung. Gloria G.O. 10197, side b, matrix Bi 412, 1932. YouTube transfer uploaded 19 June 2014. Accessed 21 August 2026.
sources.title: Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen? — Gloria G.O. 10197
sources.creator: Melody Gents, modernes Schlager-Quartett mit Orchester
sources.researchNote: The label, matrix, performer and authorship details are transcribed in the uploader's description; the disc itself is not shown. The description credits music to Dr. Bronislaw Kaper and Walter Jurmann and words to Fritz Rotter.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10155, “Mondnacht in Sanssouci” (Eric Harden with John Hendrik, 1931)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester, refrain sung by John Hendrik. “Mondnacht in Sanssouci.” Gloria G.O. 10155, matrix Bi 80, recorded 29 April 1931. Title list at musiktiteldb.de, compiled by Henry König from discographic and trade sources. Accessed 21 August 2026.
sources.title: Mondnacht in Sanssouci — Gloria G.O. 10155
sources.creator: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester; John Hendrik, refrain vocal
sources.researchNote: No publicly accessible transfer of this disc was located during the recording-link audit.

sources.shortCitation: D 4431, “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen” (Eric Harden’s danseorkester, 1932)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden’s danseorkester, refrain sung by Carljohann Volbach. “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen.” From the sound film Melodie der Liebe; catalogue number D 4431, matrix Bi 644, 1932. Digital transfer published on archive.org from the 78 rpm collection of Leif Druedahl. Accessed 24 August 2026.
sources.title: Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen — D 4431
sources.creator: Eric Harden’s danseorkester; Carljohann Volbach, refrain vocal
sources.repository: Internet Archive, 78 rpm collection of Leif Druedahl
sources.researchNote: The item gives the catalogue number D 4431 and the matrix number Bi 644 but does not name the label, and the transfer carries sound alone. The matrix identifies the master as the Gloria issue G.O. 10303, recorded in Berlin, studio 4, on 11 June 1932 and released in November 1932 according to the title list at musiktiteldb.de; the Danish wording of the performer credit belongs to the pressing, not to that recording session.

sources.shortCitation: Pfau, Lexikon der deutschen Tanzmusik, vol. 4 (1998), pp. 451–452
sources.fullCitation: H. Pfau. Lexikon der deutschen Tanzmusik 1925–1945. Band 4: Foxtrott u.ä., H–Ich. Leverkusen, 1998, pp. 451–452. DOI 10.22032/dbt.57689.
sources.title: Ich geh’ nie von dir fort — discographic entry
sources.creator: H. Pfau
sources.researchNote: The entry identifies the song as a 1933 Austrian foxtrot from the film released in Germany as “Madame wünscht keine Kinder”, credits the music to Walter Jurmann and Dr. B. Kaper and the words to Fritz Rotter and Max Kolpe, and lists two commercial issues: Artiphon 8489 by Eddy Walis and Gloria G.O. 10725 by Fred Bird.
